package.name: Card Editor
package.description: Rewrites character cards from your directives while preserving each card's voice and aligning it with referenced lore. Runs on a single card or as bulk dispatch across selected characters, with verdict review, edit-and-retry, and session management in its runs panel. Open a character card and choose Run Card Editor, or select characters and choose Card Editor for a bulk session, to propose changes for approval.

card-editor.name: Card Editor
card-editor.description: Rewrites character cards from your directives while preserving each card's voice and aligning it with referenced lore. Runs on a single card or as bulk dispatch across selected characters, with verdict review, edit-and-retry, and session management in its runs panel.

standard.name: Standard rewrite
standard.description: Balanced rewrite preset: applies the instruction across the card while preserving each card's voice, facts, and intent.

strict.name: Strict surgical
strict.description: Surgical preset: the smallest whole-field rewrite that satisfies the instruction, touching only the fields it explicitly targets.

rebalance.name: Field rebalancing
rebalance.description: Field rebalancing preset: moves content between description, personality, backstory, appearance, and scenario to match each field's meaning while preserving every fact.
